topic: Outer hip pain keeping you up at night
caption:
Outer hip pain when you lie on your side? 🛌
This is common when the side-hip tendons are compressed and irritated (gluteal tendinopathy).

✔ Pillow between knees
✔ Avoid crossing legs
✔ Progressive glute strength
